text: 🔥🇲🇽 Fox meets Alito to build a 2027 opposition alliance. Sheinbaum: "the road back to corruption and privilege." "They're on a very good path... the road back to corruption and privilege. That's their road. Fox and Alito together — the new vision of Mexican politics." — Claudia Sheinbaum on the PRIAN Ex-PAN president Vicente Fox met PRI leader Alejandro "Alito" Moreno to forge an opposition bloc for 2027. Sheinbaum called Fox "a traitor to democracy" and dismissed the PRI-PAN — "the PRIAN" — as one and the same: "here there's a national project; over there, a return to the past."

🇲🇽🌎 Trump moves to strip protection from the Mexican gray wolf. Sheinbaum: it's a species we have to conserve. "What has to happen between the United States and Mexico is coordination... beyond being on both sides of the border, it's a species we have to conserve." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on Trump's wolf order Trump signed an order giving his Interior Secretary 90 days to decide whether to drop the wolf's Endangered Species Act protection. Courts blocked the same move in his first term. The lobo gris is a transborder species — protected in Mexico and under international protocols.

🇲🇽⚖️ No new taxes in 2027. "There has been no tax increase, and there won't be." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the 2027 economic package Ahead of the 2027 budget (due September 9), Sheinbaum said higher revenue will come from fighting tax evasion and shell-company invoicing — not new taxes — while social programs keep their funding.

🇲🇽🛢️ Gasoline held under 24 pesos a liter — nationwide. "11,872 stations are selling regular gasoline below 24 pesos per liter, and the 27-peso target for diesel is being met across the country." — Profeco, fuel price report Under the voluntary fuel-price agreement, Profeco also aims to keep 24 basic-basket products under 910 pesos.

🇲🇽🌎 The state remittance card beats every bank. "For a US$400 transfer, Mexico's public Finabien card delivers 6,892.09 pesos — the best exchange rate on the market, above every commercial operator." — Profeco, "Quién es Quién en los Precios" Finabien is the government-run remittance system. Profeco's weekly price watch showed it remains the cheapest way for migrants to send money home from the United States.

🇲🇽✊ Welfare isn't charity — it's the economy. "It's direct support not only for the people, but also for the economy. It will let us keep lifting millions and millions of Mexicans out of poverty." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the Bienestar programs Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez reported roughly 42.8 million beneficiaries by the end of 2026, backed by close to 1 trillion pesos a year: pensions for 13.7M seniors, 2M people with disabilities, women aged 60–64, plus 23 million home health visits.

🇲🇽🌎 Trump drapes North America in the US flag. Sheinbaum: Mexico is not and will never be a colony. "In the month of the homeland, we reaffirm that Mexico is not and will never be a colony or protectorate of any foreign country." — Claudia Sheinbaum, September 7, 2026 Trump posted a map of North America covered by the US flag, labeling the Gulf of Mexico "Gulf of America." Sheinbaum answered the next day, in the middle of Mexico's independence month.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Fobaproa: the bank bailout Mexicans will "never finish paying"</u>

Sheinbaum is dedicating a special mañanera to the Fobaproa after a new Finance Ministry study reached a damning verdict: the 1990s bank rescue that Zedillo turned into public debt "will never be paid off," because every year only the interest gets covered while the principal is rolled over with fresh debt. Three decades on, the people still carry the cost of private banks' losses.
